currencyNote: Legacy/supporting source. The staged source map notes that the 2016 AAP clinical report states clinical reports expire after five years unless reaffirmed or revised, and current reaffirmation was not established in the mapping pass.
authorityBoundary: Legacy neonatal clinical-context support only. Current neonatal guidance, physician orders, institutional NICU policy, and medication/device protocols govern management. Current AASM Scoring Manual Version 3 infant/pediatric respiratory rules govern PSG scoring when formal sleep-study scoring applies. NICU bedside-monitoring definitions, alarm thresholds, and response practices are not interchangeable with PSG scoring rules.
